# Layout native distributions

ELK0.12.0 uses EPL2.0 (secondary GPL3 terms in included license); @lume/kiwi0.4.4 BSD3; libavoid-js0.5.0-beta.5 LGPL2.1-or-later. Included notices are unmodified. Wasm is separately replaceable/served, never inlined into the proprietary application bundle. Preserve notices and provide corresponding source/relinking access when distributing; source/build instructions: https://github.com/Aksem/libavoid-js and https://github.com/mjwybrow/adaptagrams . Exact npm integrity and Wasm hash in quality/acceptance-evidence/layout-native-provenance.json. No claim that this beta is faster than another version.
